one_line: Last independent Nawab of Bengal, who faced Robert Clive at the Battle of Plassey in 1757.

appearance.age_look: Late teens to early 20s, slim but athletic build, slightly narrow shoulders with a poised, youthful stance.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp jawline, wheatish Bengali complexion, straight nose, expressive dark brown eyes with noticeably thick brows, a faint trimmed moustache, and a default expression of tense determination mixed with wounded pride.
appearance.hair: Dark brown hair kept short and neat under a tall, slightly conical Mughal-style turban wrapped in deep emerald green fabric with a narrow gold border, fronted by a small central jewel and a subtle white feather plume angled slightly to his left.
appearance.costume: A knee-length, finely tailored Mughal angarkha in rich deep red silk with subtle gold floral buta motifs and a wrap-front tied on his right side, worn over an off-white cotton jama-like underlayer; paired with narrow, slightly gathered churidar trousers in muted cream, a broad emerald green silk patka (waist sash) with thin gold stripes knotted on his left hip and trailing down, and a light cream muslin shawl draped over his left shoulder and across his torso; he wears simple but elegant gold stud earrings, a single medium-length gold necklace with a small pendant, a slim gold signet-style ring on his right hand, and soft brown leather mojari shoes with gently upturned toes and minimal embroidery.
appearance.signature: A traditional Indo-Mughal talwar with a slightly curved steel blade, a brass hilt with disc pommel and knuckle-bow, and a brown leather-covered wooden scabbard trimmed with simple brass bands, worn slung from his left side on a dark brown leather belt partially hidden under his green patka.

ref_desc: Siraj ud-Daulah is a late-teen slim Nawab with a wheatish complexion, oval face, short dark hair under an emerald green Mughal turban, wearing a deep red gold-patterned angarkha, cream churidar, green patka, cream shawl, gold jewellery, brown mojari shoes, and carrying a brass-hilted talwar in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Siraj ud-Daulah as a dignified young Nawab of Bengal: a late-teen slim figure with a wheatish complexion, oval face, sharp jawline, thick brows, and expressive dark brown eyes, bearing a faint trimmed moustache and a default expression of tense determination and wounded pride. His short dark brown hair is mostly hidden beneath a tall, slightly conical Mughal turban wrapped in deep emerald green fabric with a narrow gold border, accented by a small central jewel and a modest white feather plume angled slightly to his left. He wears a knee-length deep red silk angarkha with subtle gold floral buta motifs, the wrap-front tied neatly on his right side, over an off-white cotton underlayer; his narrow cream churidar trousers wrinkle slightly at the ankles. Around his waist is a broad emerald green silk patka with thin gold stripes, knotted on his left hip with its ends trailing down, partially covering a dark brown leather belt. A light cream muslin shawl is draped over his left shoulder and diagonally across his torso, adding soft folds. He has simple gold stud earrings, a single medium-length gold necklace with a small pendant, and a slim gold signet-style ring on his right hand. On his feet are soft brown leather mojari shoes with gently upturned toes and minimal embroidery. His signature weapon is a traditional Indo-Mughal talwar with a slightly curved steel blade, a brass hilt with disc pommel and knuckle-bow, sheathed in a brown leather-covered wooden scabbard with simple brass bands, hanging from his left side; show him in neutral full-front, side, and three-quarter poses that highlight his deep red, emerald green, cream, gold, and brown colour palette, emphasizing realistic historical clothing textures within a clean shonen-anime design.
